title: A/R Summary: the Location menu has a search box above 8 locations
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at nine or more locations on today's date, among them {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; the other eight are staging locations made for this test (ZZAUTOTEST S5-09 Location 1 to ZZAUTOTEST S5-09 Location 8).
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Location chip.
  2. Look at the top of the menu for a search box and read its placeholder.
  3. Type the first word of {Location-A}'s name into it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens with every location ticked.
  • Step 2: a search box shows, with the placeholder "Search locations".
  • Step 3: the list narrows to the locations whose names match, {Location-A} among them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R2: “The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".”
